name: Glory-Hound
body:
You fight recklessly to prove yourself in glorious combat.

Prerequisite: Base Attack Bonus +1

Effect: -2 on your Armour Class during combat until you drop an opponent. Doesn’t apply in combats against only one foe.

Source not confirmed for this entry. If this is your work, use the Feedback link below to let us know so we can credit it properly.
